name: quoted_document_as_claim
why: role=user says who sent, not who claims
fix: found requires first-person statement; pasted docs are clues only

name: question_as_evidence
input: do you remember the disk I mentioned last week
why: a question asserts nothing about the past

name: assistant_reply_as_evidence
input: did I have X for breakfast
fix: role=user only for evidence; assistant text is context, not proof

name: one_match_excuses_whole_message
input: one real quote + one fabricated claim
fix: verify per citation; strip only the unsupported sentence

name: not_checked_rendered_as_absent
why: claims a search that never happened
fix: four states; not_checked carries no searched scope

name: trigger_too_narrow
why: trigger required time words or fixed templates
fix: trigger on (time word | memory question) OR (interrogative + object exists)

name: fallback_impersonates_assistant
observed: canned sentence posted as her own words
why: receiver cannot tell it is system text
fix: prefix the fallback and log fallback_text

name: fallback_mutes_rest_of_turn
why: turn-level boolean instead of per-message dedupe
fix: dedupe on the single text; return an explicit error

name: statement_triggers_history_lookup
input: I had X for breakfast today
observed: suspected (looked up an older similar event)
why: statement mistaken for a question about the past

name: resolved_cost_still_fires
why: no resolved_at field; elapsed time treated as closure
fix: resolved_at set only by explicit closure or a later transition statement
